actor: Two bald men with glasses: the one in the navy suit (left) and the one in the green suit (right); they pass or hand over a wallet
before: In frame 1 the man in the green suit (right) holds the wallet, while the navy-suited man reaches toward it.
after: In frame 3 the navy-suited man (left) holds the wallet; the green-suited man gestures with a raised arm.
change: The wallet moved from the green-suited man to the navy-suited man (a handover or transfer of money/wallet), and the men's gestures swapped.
consequence: Money or control of funds is transferred from one person to the other, suggesting someone entrusts their money to another (an investing or trust relationship), with some uncertainty about it.
message: One person hands over his wallet or money to another to manage, which is the core of an investor-and-manager (Buffett) relationship.
